shortDescription: Manage files, photos, videos, torrents and remote storage in one app.

microsoftStoreImages.description: Local files, tabs, tags, and rich previews in one focused desktop view.
Scan albums, media folders, and visual collections without losing context.
Import qBittorrent backups and keep .torrent files and magnet links in one searchable library.
Find, review, and act on files with an integrated assistant side panel.
Review assistant actions before anything changes in your files.
Keep a file-aware conversation beside the workspace you are using.
Pick popular or recent tags, or browse the tag tree, without leaving your files.
Build lightweight systems for projects, references, and media collections.
Build parent-child tag hierarchies and expand the exact branch you need.
Scan bulky folders, review junk candidates, and ask CB Agent before deleting.
